issues.title: Feature request: Enhance search syntax, such as whole-word matching and regular expression search.

issues.title: [Bug] Chrome crashes with "Out of Memory" error when viewing large profiles (~375MB)
issues.evidence: Cancellable streaming duration imports now frame one bounded event at a time for native JSON parsing, keeping byte/event/depth guards and format fallbacks. Three fresh-process PLC comparisons reduced median import time from 4336 to 2493 ms and median peak RSS from 613 to 579 MiB. Export equality verified; general out-of-core storage/rendering and original OOM cases remain open. Complete-event queues now reuse original begin events and retain compact end records; already chronological queues avoid sort workspace. Selected-stack details render at most 100 ancestors per page. Streaming coverage and original OOM reproductions remain incomplete; this is not an out-of-core viewer.
